scope: Durable pre-dispatch recovery records, explicit reload recovery and account/source/cross-tab publication guards

checks: Two browser tabs reopen exact legacy project/input bytes; another owner cannot list or open them.
Job updates write metadata only; stale update/removal cannot overwrite another tab or alter retained evidence.
Completed job status and exact workspace survive a full browser reload without any service request.
Deletion removes payload and metadata atomically; a late publication check rejects the old handle.
Quota failure after metadata put rolls back both stores; pre-aborted creation leaves previous records intact.
Eight-entry capacity and duplicate identity fail without evicting or resubmitting existing requests.
Expiry deletes only known-format temporary entries; future records remain unchanged until explicit removal.
The 64 MiB total budget rejects another record below the count limit, without loading or evicting existing payloads.
Corrupt retained evidence is rejected without rewriting its original bytes.
No service request before explicit discovery; local preparation previews selected evidence; consent required before POST
Actual HTTP service and provider adapter return source-linked suggestions; only selected PNG and text are dispatched
Explicit suggestion adoption changes editable labels only; final manual review still required; generated gradient and downloadable provenance follow
Fabricated model observation IDs fail closed without changing the manual draft
Editing source review detaches local polling and preserves the request; explicit cancellation stops its job, and late output cannot overwrite the new draft
Lost POST response recovers the identical persisted job without a second provider invocation
390px view has no horizontal overflow; keyboard activation applies suggestions
Unavailable authentication leaves the complete local review and deterministic generation path usable
Uncertain request survives draft replacement; explicit recovery reuses the old job and cannot adopt stale suggestions
Uncertain request survives source replacement; explicit recovery reuses the old job and cannot adopt stale suggestions
Completion winning the cancellation race is reported accurately and does not apply suggestions

An unknown submitted request survives opening a V4 manual-value project. Failed cancellation retains recover/check/cancel controls; explicit retry cancels the same service job without provider retry, suggestion adoption or any project mutation.
never-submitted recovery performs lookup only, releases controls, and requires fresh preparation/consent
deleted recovery performs lookup only, releases controls, and requires fresh preparation/consent
Account change after preparation rejects submission before creating a job for the new principal

PDF source, edited draft and selected images survive reload/account partitioning; unknown and completed requests reopen without another submission or provider call, including after applying suggestions.
Deleting a request in another tab during the final account check prevents stale PDF restoration and retains the newer draft.
An actual browser storage quota failure prevents submission before any provider work and preserves the current draft.
No ambient service/provider requests; missing session leaves PDF fallback enabled
PKCE browser link and authenticated cookie callback connect the real server manager without exposing credentials
Explicit selection dispatches one native job; full-precision paints, gradients, text, modes and gaps survive download; source text stays inert
Lost submission response retains its recovery record through a later 401 and reconciles the exact existing job after an explicit Check capture action
Completed native capture reopens after reload using the saved job, without rediscovery, submission, or another Figma API request.
File access failure retains prior capture and allows recovery without substituting empty evidence
Cancel reaches the owned server job and retains the previous completed capture
Confirmed authentication and disabled-processor rejections release pending state and leave recovery controls enabled
Completion winning cancellation remains recoverable and is never reported as cancelled
Deleted unknown capture releases controls without another submission or replacing prior evidence.
Offline packet with a valid hash but conflicting repeated node identity is rejected without hiding a source restriction
Deleting a saved capture in another tab while its result is arriving prevents stale publication and releases recovery controls.
Large source text is paged and gap/property previews are bounded; complete source data remains in the packet
Disconnect preserves portable evidence; offline reopen makes no request; 390px viewport and keyboard connection control work
Explicit host/session check and capture produce rendered evidence through the real owned job service; no ambient requests or user browser credentials.
Keyboard review preserves named CSS observations, requires scope/text decisions, extends a source scale, and enforces the product gradient restriction.
Changing decisions removes stale results; offline browser and Node reopen retain exact source/model/paint and browser SVG/CSS/JSON bytes.
Invalid and future input retain the prior usable result; future original bytes remain downloadable.
Lost submission response and a later 401 retain the same recovery envelope; reconciliation returns the existing job without duplicate capture.
Completed website capture reopens after reload without another submission or page capture.
Cancellation reaches the owned job and retains the previous completed evidence.
Repeating the exact retained request directs the user to its saved copy without replacing it or submitting again.
Deleted unknown submission releases capture controls without resubmitting or replacing prior evidence.

review.quality: late-publication and stale pending fixes verified; duplicate-create branch rechecked
review.efficiency: metadata-only status writes and revision reads verified

limitations: Synthetic provider transport and host sessions only
Temporary browser cache is not encrypted account storage
Expiry cleanup requires Studio to run
Source revision history and explicit refresh remain open
No integrated release gate, merge, push or deployment
No designer or assistive-technology acceptance from these tests
